meta.title: Escape from Tarkov - Customs layout reference (post-0.16 data set, checked against patches to 2026-10-29)

frame.name: customs_m
frame.z: south positive (north = -z = top of the 2D map)
frame.y: height, game y (ground ~1.0-1.5 in the centre)
frame.origin: x_e = 0 at game x = 163; z_s = 0 at game z = -35 (centre of the tarkov.dev 2D bounds)
frame.note: The 2D map is 1070 x 544 m; the playable polygon is smaller (see boundary).

transforms.game_to_frame: x_e = 163 - x_game ; z_s = z_game + 35 ; y = y_game (tarkov.dev coordinateRotation 180)
transforms.frame_to_roblox: Roblox X = x_e, Roblox Z = z_s (north = -Z, same as Roblox forward), Roblox Y = y. Part yaw = -rot_deg: CFrame.new(cx, y, cz) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.rad(rot_deg), 0) with Size = (w, height, d); w lies along the rotated local X axis.
transforms.rot_deg_definition: angle of the long (w) side from +x (east) toward +z (south), i.e. clockwise on a north-up map; range -90..90

accuracy.A: footprints traced from tarkov-dev-svg-maps Customs.svg (last edited 2024-01-10, i.e. 0.12.x geometry): +-3-5 m position, +-3 m size; labels/floor extents from tarkov.dev (updated 2025-01 for 0.16) +-2 m
accuracy.B: identified by matching extents/spawn points/icons: +-5-10 m
accuracy.D: no position source; do not rely on it

caveats: No live tarkov.dev API data (api.tarkov.dev blocked: HTTP 403); spawns/extract rules come from the SPT server database instead.

Building shapes are the pre-0.16 SVG; the 0.16 rework changed art/interiors and opened three industrial buildings, but tarkov.dev kept the same map bounds and labels, so the macro layout is assumed unchanged.
Extracts added/renamed by patch 1.2.0.0 (2026-10-06) are not identifiable from any retrievable source.

boundary.note: SVG Limit polygon simplified from 197 to 97 vertices (eps 1.5 m). Edge extract icons lie within ~5-7 m of it, but RUAF Roadblock (-18 m), Military Base CP (-25 m) and Administration Gate (-6 m) lie outside, so treat the polygon as +-25 m in the north-centre notch and the SW corner.

river.flow: north to south; Main Bridge at (233,42) carries the highway; Junk Bridge decks at (218,82) and (245,75); island polygon at (233,81)

spawns.note: Source: SPT server database (bigmap/base.json, compatibleTarkovVersion 0.16.9.40743 era, HEAD 2026-08-10) converted to the frame; not the live game. Point = [x, z, y, facing_deg]; facing_deg uses the same convention as rot_deg (0 = east, 90 = south). Spawn radius 70 m (collider) for scav points.

pmc_group_east.note: east half; 10 clusters of 5 points. The "Customs" entry point is the one whose extracts lie in the WEST (ZB-1011, ZB-1012, Old Gas Station) plus the shared ones.

pmc_group_west.note: west half; 14 clusters of 5 points; its extracts lie in the EAST (Crossroads, Trailer Park, RUAF Roadblock, Smugglers Boat) plus the shared ones.

coop_group.note: PMC co-op group spawn: all within x 57..67, z 47..55 (south of the boiler complex)

coop_opposite.note: co-op opposing/scav-side starts spread along the main road (x -407..297, z 16..51)
